what: Real model-driven paired whole-task comparison (DoD criterion 8, WO-3). Same model, same whole task; arm A uses the Bash tool, arm B uses pi-nobash query_jsonl/json_query. n=2 per arm. No speedup is claimed; duration is dominated by model latency and the two arms are within run-to-run noise.
task_prompt: Analyze the file workload.jsonl in the current directory. Each line is one JSON object with fields id, ts, service, region, status, latency_ms. Task: filter the records where status == "error", group them by service and region, count the records per group, sort the groups by count descending, and take the top 10. Your final reply must be ONLY a JSON array of the top 10 groups as objects {"service": ..., "region": ..., "count": ...}, highest count first. No other text.
ground_truth: computed deterministically with node (filter/group/count/sort desc/top 10); stored as ground-truth.json in the run workspace
arm_a_commands: cd /tmp/wt-bench && pi -p --mode json --no-session -nc -ns -np --thinking low --provider deepseek --model deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash -t 'read,bash' "$TASK" > armA.json
arm_b_commands: cd /tmp/wt-bench && pi -p --mode json --no-session -nc -ns -np --thinking low --provider deepseek --model deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash -e /Users/afshin/Documents/dev/pi-nobash/extensions/pi-nobash.ts -t 'read,query_jsonl,json_query' "$TASK" > armB.json
extension_load_verification: Arm B extension load verified three ways before depending on it: (1) a probe extension loaded via -e executed a registered tool end-to-end (tool_execution_start/tool_execution_end events); (2) with pi-nobash loaded, the model listed its tools as 'read, query_jsonl'; (3) arm B transcripts contain actual query_jsonl tool calls. Note: agent_end.toolsAdded does NOT list extension tools (empty even for a working probe extension), so it is not a valid load indicator.

runs.order: B then A (order swapped to cancel cache/order effects)

correctness_criterion: final reply parses as a JSON array of exactly 10 rows, set-equal to the ground-truth rows (service, region, count), with counts non-increasing; the task specified no tiebreaker for equal counts, so ordering among ties is not scored
summary: Both arms produced correct results in all 4 runs. Turns: A 5/4, B 4/4. Wall time A 6077/6531 ms, B 6710/6981 ms; the difference is within model-latency noise. No speedup or slowdown is claimed. Arm B tool surface verified restricted: no bash tool available (allowlist) and the pi-nobash bash blocker was active via the loaded extension.
caveats: n=2 per arm; single fixture size (5000 lines); single model (deepseek-v4-flash at thinking low).
Actual provider cost per run was ~$0.005-$0.02 (measured via the usage events), not the ~$0.001 estimate.
Token totals are per-call sums from the --mode json usage events; cacheRead dominates and varies with call count.
The deterministic paired fixture (paired.test.ts / paired-results.json) remains the repeatable check; this file records the one-off real-model evidence and is not asserted by any test.
